courses.title: Interaction Design for Product Designers
courses.description: By the end of Interaction Design for Product Designers, you'll be able to apply interaction design confidently in Product Designer work, with a working sense of where design critique fits alongside it. The course moves from core interaction design technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at design critique woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to design critique
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying User Research
courses.description: Applying User Research is a focused course on user research for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying user research on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying user research to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing user research through guided exercises
Building a short user research exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Getting Started with Accessibility Auditing
courses.description: Getting Started with Accessibility Auditing is a short introduction to accessibility auditing for people moving toward a Product Designer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show accessibility auditing in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if accessibility auditing is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying accessibility auditing to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing accessibility auditing through guided exercises
Building a short accessibility auditing exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: A Short Guide to Packaging Design
courses.description: A Short Guide to Packaging Design walks you through the basics of packaging design, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of packaging design, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying packaging design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing packaging design through guided exercises
Building a short packaging design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Interaction Design Essentials
alternates.description: Interaction Design Essentials walks you through the basics of interaction design, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of interaction design, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Building a short interaction design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Interaction Design Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Interaction Design Techniques goes beyond the basics of interaction design, for people already working toward a Product Designer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in interaction design and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Building a short interaction design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
